C0805.title: 33 Malicious npm Packages Use Dependency Confusion to Harvest Developer Environment Data
C0805.summary: In May 2026, Microsoft disclosed a dependency confusion campaign in which attackers used 33 malicious npm packages to collect reconnaissance data from developer and build environments.
